value.rationale: The motivating source specifically reports severe BFloat16 logistic bifurcation degradation. The exact all-state bfloat16 graph is a natural fidelity invariant, and the 275-edge versus 10423-starting-state basin inversion quantifies a dramatic, nonlocal change from a very sparse change in local rounding. It is not a renamed old binary16 table because the format and outcomes differ, and is not claimed as a general theorem about all precisions or real-state basins.
